approximations: No outline (private, village-level location): size ≈ 12.4 × 11.4 m scaled from the standing-seam pan count (≈ 24 pans at ≈ 0.55 m) and the vertical drone view of the finished house; roof pitch ≈ 42°, eave ≈ 5.75 m, ridge ≈ 11.2 m and storey heights estimated; openings on the façades not seen in the photographs are interpreted; terrain shown flat (the site slopes towards the loggia gable). Roof colour: COLOR METAL's photographs of the finished house (company post, 2 Sept.) show a light-grey standing seam, whereas the register lists PREFA bronze — modelled as photographed (to be checked).

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografiile COLOR METAL ale casei finalizate (dronă, fațade, acoperiș): dimensiunile, panta și înălțimile etajelor sunt estimate (nu există contur), golurile de pe fațadele nefotografiate sunt interpretate, terenul în pantă este redat plan; culoarea acoperișului urmează fotografiile.
note.hu: A COLOR METAL elkészült házról készült fotói (drón, homlokzatok, tető) alapján értelmezett makett: a méretek, a tetőhajlás és a szintmagasságok becsültek (körvonal nincs), a nem fotózott homlokzatok nyílásai értelmezettek, a lejtős terep síkként jelenik meg; a tető színe a fotókat követi.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from COLOR METAL's photographs of the finished house (drone, façades, roof): size, roof pitch and storey heights are estimated (no outline), openings on façades not photographed are interpreted, the sloping site is shown flat; the roof colour follows the photographs.
